Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. 23	// SSEEvent represents a change event sent to SSE clients.
24	type SSEEvent struct {
25		Type SSEEventType `json:"type"`
26		// Name is the affected resource name (e.g., "memos/xxxx").
27		// For reaction events, this is the memo resource name that the reaction belongs to.
28		Name string `json:"name"`
29		// Parent is the parent memo resource name when the affected resource is a comment.
30		Parent string `json:"parent,omitempty"`

37	// Returns nil if marshaling fails (error is logged).
